def test_auth_signup_and_login():
    username, token, headers = create_user_and_verify()

    # Login
    login_url = get_url("gateway", "/auth/login")
    resp = requests.post(login_url, json={"user": username, "password": "password123"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    token_login = resp.json()["token"]
    assert token_login is not None

    # Verify login by getting user info
    me_url = get_url("gateway", "/user/me")
    headers_login = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_login}"}
    resp_me = requests.get(me_url, headers=headers_login, timeout=10)
    assert resp_me.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_me.status_code}: {resp_me.text}"
    assert resp_me.json()["user"] == username

def test_wallet_topup_and_balance():
    username, token, headers = create_user_and_verify()

    # Initial balance
    balance_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance")
    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == 0

    # Topup
    topup_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup")
    resp = requests.get(topup_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify balance updated
    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    new_balance = resp.json()["balance"]
    assert new_balance > 0

    # Topup again (negative test)
    resp = requests.get(topup_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_wallet_transfer_success():
    # User A
    _, _, headers_a = create_user_and_verify()

    # Topup User A
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify A balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a_initial = resp.json()["balance"]

    # User B
    _, _, headers_b = create_user_and_verify()

    # Get User B address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json()["address"]
    balance_b_initial = resp.json()["balance"]

    # Transfer A -> B
    transfer_amount = balance_a_initial / 2
    transfer_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer")
    payload = {"to": address_b, "amount": transfer_amount}
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify A balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_a_initial - transfer_amount

    # Verify B balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_b_initial + transfer_amount

def test_wallet_multiple_transfers():
    # User A
    _, _, headers_a = create_user_and_verify()

    # Topup User A
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify A balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a_initial = resp.json()["balance"]

    # User B
    _, _, headers_b = create_user_and_verify()

    # Get User B address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json()["address"]
    balance_b_initial = resp.json()["balance"]

    # Transfer A -> B twice
    transfer_amount = balance_a_initial / 4
    transfer_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer")
    payload = {"to": address_b, "amount": transfer_amount}

    # First transfer
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify A balance after first transfer
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_a_initial - transfer_amount

    # Second transfer
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify A balance after second transfer
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_a_initial - (2 * transfer_amount)

    # Verify B balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_b_initial + (2 * transfer_amount)
